errors.text_span: 两个柱状图组分别用蓝色（粘合式）和橙色（组合式）表示
errors.evidence: The chart has two groups on the x-axis, which are "词例数量" (Number of word examples) and "使用频率" (Frequency of use). The colors represent the series within each group: blue for "粘合式" (agglutinative) and orange for "组合式" (compound). The description incorrectly states that there are two groups represented by the colors, which confuses the grouping dimension (x-axis) with the series dimension (legend).
The description uses the word "约为" (approximately) twice when reporting the values 34,805 and 43,040. However, these are the exact values displayed as data labels on the bars, not approximations.
